title: Multimodal Machine Learning: A Survey and Taxonomy
authors: Tadas Baltrušaitis, Chaitanya Ahuja, Louis-Philippe Morency
publisher: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
annotation: Karya ilmiah kanonikal mengenai taksonomi komprehensif pembelajaran mesin multimodal: representasi, translasi, penyelarasan, fusi, dan ko-learning.

title: Attention Bottlenecks for Multimodal Fusion
authors: Arsha Nagrani, Shan Yang, Anurag Arnab, Aren Jansen, Cordelia Schmid, Chen Sun
publisher: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
annotation: Memperkenalkan mekanisme bottleneck tokens untuk fusi lintas-modalitas berbasis Transformer yang membatasi aliran informasi berlebih dan menghemat komputasi kuadratik.

title: What Makes Training Multi-Modal Classification Networks Hard?
authors: Weiyao Wang, Du Tran, Matt Feiszli
publisher: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Menganalisis fenomena dominasi modalitas tunggal dan laju pembelajaran asimetris, serta mengusulkan Gradient Blending untuk fusi multimodal yang stabil.

title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
authors: Alec Radford, Jong Wook Kim, Chris Hallacy, Aditya Ramesh, Gabriel Goh, Sandhini Agarwal, Girish Sastry, Amanda Askell, Pamela Mishkin, Jack Clark, Gretchen Krueger, Ilya Sutskever
annotation: Pondasi arsitektur dual-encoder CLIP yang menghubungkan pemahaman visual dengan supervisi bahasa alami berskala masif.
